summary: Executed v2.0 backend+frontend validation for AI remediation and terminal autocomplete. Backend remediation/auth/scan regression passed (9/9). Frontend mostly passed, but scan-id Tab autocomplete for summary/cancel/xml did not complete IDs in UI, and mobile layout remains functionally cramped due persistent sidebar.

ui_bugs.issue: Tab completion does not expand scan ID token for summary/cancel/xml (input stays as typed prefix)

integration_issues.issue: After running scans command, `summary 7` + Tab, `cancel 7` + Tab, and `xml 7` + Tab did not autocomplete to scan_id prefixes, despite available recent scans

issues: Persistent full sidebar consumes most viewport width
Critical content/controls become too cramped for practical mobile use

action_items: Fix TerminalPage scan-id Tab completion path for summary/cancel/xml second token
Re-test scan-id completion with both empty second token (`summary `) and typed prefix (`summary 7`)
Implement responsive sidebar behavior for mobile (collapse/overlay) to preserve workable content area
critical_code_review_comments: backend/core/security.py still has a fallback JWT secret literal; per env-only policy this should fail fast when JWT_SECRET is missing.
Terminal autocomplete uses async scan-id fetch at Tab time; observed behavior indicates unresolved runtime path where scan IDs are not applied to completions despite available scans.
seed_data_creation: Created transient QA vuln scans during backend tests; created and deleted one UI schedule in scheduler flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend remediation endpoints validated with real Claude (uncached then cached true identical persisted plan). Frontend remediation rendering/metadata/collapse/copy passed on seeded scan where remediation already existed. Terminal command verb cycling and preset third-token completion passed. Reproducible failure remains for scan-id second-token Tab completion (`summary/cancel/xml`).
rca of the issue: Reproduction: Login QA -> Terminal -> run `scans` -> type `summary 7` + Tab (or `cancel 7`, `xml 7`) => token not expanded. Suspected RCA: scan-id completion path in TerminalPage (`completionNeedsScanIds` + async `loadScanIds` + `getTerminalCompletions`) is not applying loaded IDs at runtime even when scan history exists. Mitigation: instrument `completeInput` with temporary logs for tokens/matches and ensure `loadScanIds` return is passed into matcher; add unit test for `summary 7` and e2e test for keyboard Tab completion behavior.
